hero.headline: About Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers
hero.subheadline: India's premier public sector fertilizer company, serving farmers and the nation for over 50 years.

overview.headline: Who We Are
overview.body1: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF) is a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers. Incorporated in 1978, RCF has grown into one of India's largest manufacturers of fertilizers and industrial chemicals.
overview.body2: With two major manufacturing complexes at Trombay (Mumbai) and Thal (Raigad, Maharashtra), RCF produces a wide range of fertilizers including Urea, Complex Fertilizers, Biofertilizers, and specialty nutrients — serving millions of farmers across India.

mission.headline: Mission & Vision
mission.mission: To be a leading fertilizer company contributing to India's food security by providing quality fertilizers and agri-inputs to farmers at affordable prices.
mission.vision: To be the most preferred and trusted fertilizer brand in India, known for quality, innovation, and farmer-centric service.
